envelope.description: RepoIndexingError and ensureRepoQueryable; ensureNonEmptyClosure and the scope mappings refuse a repository under index

body.title: RepoIndexingError and ensureRepoQueryable; ensureNonEmptyClosure and the scope mappings refuse a repository under index
body.summary: src/analyze/context/invariants.ts: RepoIndexingError (code 'repo-indexing', data: repoPath, status, run figures) and ensureRepoQueryable(scope, deps?) reading the registry (longest registered prefix) and the running record (default: src/indexer/run-record.ts): 'indexing' with figures, or figures not known with no record; 'error' with lastRun's figures, or unknown figures and errorMsg for a row without lastRun. It skips (logs, no throw) when the registry read fails or the registry is pristine, and does not check a connection scope. ensureNonEmptyClosure calls it first. scopeErrorMapping maps it; ScopeErrorCode/TaskRefusalCode, RunErrorCode and AnalyzeRpcErrorCode gain 'repo-indexing'; both classifyShaperError mappings carry the data; the walker records a refused task through taskRefusalMapping. Grounding: the existing longest-prefix lookup of ensureNonEmptyClosure (src/analyze/context/invariants.ts:185-217) is reused by ensureRepoQueryable, not duplicated; ScopeErrorCode :100, scopeErrorMapping :118, TaskRefusalCode :129 (derived from ScopeErrorCode, so it gains the code), taskRefusalMapping :137; the walker calls it at src/analyze/executor/walker.ts:265.
acceptanceChecks: 'indexing' (with and without entities) throws RepoIndexingError with the running record's figures; with no record it says the figures are not known; 'error' with a failed lastRun throws with its figures and error; an 'error' row without lastRun throws with figures unknown and its errorMsg.
'pending' and 'ready' with no entities keep ScopeNotIndexedError and its message; a registry read that throws and a pristine registry skip the check with no refusal and no raw error.
A docs, data and infra scope on a repository under index is refused by ensureRepoQueryable; a generic intent and a connection scope are not checked.
classifyShaperError maps RepoIndexingError to 'repo-indexing' with its data in both mappings; the plan walk records a task on a repository under index with code 'repo-indexing'.

tests.name: ensureNonEmptyClosure: status 'indexing' (with and without entities) throws RepoIndexingError with the running record's figures; 'indexing' with no record says the figures are not known; 'error' with lastRun.outcome 'failed' throws with lastRun's figures and error; 'pending' and 'ready' with no entities keep ScopeNotIndexedError and its message
ensureRepoQueryable: a docs / data / infra / generic run on a repository under index is refused; an 'error' row without lastRun is refused with figures unknown and its errorMsg
ensureRepoQueryable: a registry read that throws, and a pristine registry, skip the check (no refusal, no raw error)
plan walk: the walker (executor/walker.ts) records a task whose scope's repository is under index with code 'repo-indexing' through taskRefusalMapping
classifyShaperError: RepoIndexingError maps to 'repo-indexing' with its data in both mappings
